name: Accoutrements of Bone
descr:
**Price** 700 gp

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L

**Base Armor** [Explorer's Clothing](/item/explorer-s-clothing-player-core)

---

This set of _[+1 resilient](/item/resilient-gm-core) explorer’s clothing_ is lined with magically reinforced carved bones that are connected with reinforced sinews to provide the wearer both comfort and mobility. Spikes and spines of various shapes and sizes jut menacingly from the shoulder and forearm coverings. When you wear this outfit, you gain a +2 item bonus to Occultism checks.

activations.name: Piercing Vengeance
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An enemy damages you with a melee Strike; **Effect** Jagged spines from your clothing launch themselves at the triggering enemy, dealing 6d6 piercing damage with a DC 26 [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Reflex save.
activations.effect: Jagged spines from your clothing launch themselves at the triggering enemy, dealing 6d6 piercing damage with a DC 26 [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Reflex save.
activations.trigger: An enemy damages you with a melee Strike

name: All-Seeing Eye
descr:
**Usage** affixed to armor or a weapon

---

This glass eyeball is slightly uncanny due to the two brightly colored crystal irises it sports on opposing sides. It helps combatants see their foes even in the darkest of situations.
**• Armor** You gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 2 to damage from [illusion](/trait/illusion) effects.
**• Weapon** ([fortune](/trait/fortune)) After you cast a light spell by Activating the eye, your own eyesight sharpens until the end of your next turn. If you fail the [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) to target a [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) or [hidden](/condition/hidden-player-core) opponent with a [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) with the weapon, you can reroll it and take the new result.

## All-seeing Eye

**Price** 50 gp

## Greater All-seeing Eye

**Price** 140 gp

---

The resistance increases to 4. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 20.

**Activate** **** Cast a Spell **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You cast _[_revealing light_](/spell/revealing-light-player-core)_.

name: Anointed Waterskin
descr:
**Price** 600 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1

---

This waterskin coruscates with [holy](/trait/holy) energy. After using any of the activations, the waterskin is empty, but slowly refills itself. It becomes full enough to use again at the next dawn.

activations.name: Blessed Bombard
activations.text: **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You throw the _anointed waterskin_ up to 60 feet. The water explodes out of it, with the effects of a DC 25 4th-rank _[_holy cascade_](/spell/holy-cascade-player-core-2)_.
activations.effect: You throw the _anointed waterskin_ up to 60 feet. The water explodes out of it, with the effects of a DC 25 4th-rank _[_holy cascade_](/spell/holy-cascade-player-core-2)_.

activations.name: Divine Decanting
activations.text: 1 minute (manipulate) **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You decant the water, creating up to 10 vials of _[holy water](/item/holy-water-gm-core)_. You must provide the vials. Holy water created this clearly temporary upon inspection, and fades away after 8 hours.
activations.effect: You decant the water, creating up to 10 vials of _[holy water](/item/holy-water-gm-core)_. You must provide the vials. Holy water created this clearly temporary upon inspection, and fades away after 8 hours.

activations.name: Sacred Sip
activations.text: **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You drink the water within the waterskin, granting you the effects of _[_bless_](/spell/bless-player-core)_. As normal, you can increase the spell’s radius by [Sustaining](/action/sustain-player-core) it.
activations.effect: You drink the water within the waterskin, granting you the effects of _[_bless_](/spell/bless-player-core)_. As normal, you can increase the spell’s radius by [Sustaining](/action/sustain-player-core) it.

name: Apotropaic Fulu
descr:
**Price** 25 gp

**Usage** affixed over an entrance

---

This unassuming yellow paper, affixed above a door or gate, flickers in the light. Choose [holy](/trait/holy) or [unholy](/trait/unholy); the fulu gains that trait. When a creature with the opposing trait of the fulu (unholy for a holy fulu, or vice versa) passes through the entrance, it must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save or become [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) 2; regardless of whether it succeeds, the creature becomes temporarily immune for 1 day.

name: Archer's Bulwark
descr:
**Price** 85 gp

**Usage** strapped to 1 hand

**Bulk** L

**Base Shield** Buckler

---

This embossed steel buckler ([Hardness](/rule/hardness-rules-2183) 4, HP 12, BT 6) is designed to not interfere with the hand an archer uses to pull back their bowstring. When you [Raise a Shield](/action/raise-a-shield-player-core) with this buckler, the circumstance bonus to AC it grants against ranged [Strikes](/action/strike-player-core) increases to +2. This increased bonus doesn’t apply to unusually massive ranged projectiles (such as boulders or ballista bolts).

name: Archivist's Gaze
descr:
**Price** 24,000 gp

**Usage** worn eyepiece

---

This strange contraption slides over your eyes, supernaturally sharpening your mind. While peering through it, you can feel some entity whispering to you, telling all sorts of things about the subject of your gaze. You gain a +3 item bonus to Occultism (though some entities might grant a bonus to a different skill, as determined by your GM). In addition, when you employ an exploration tactic other than [Investigating](/action/investigate-player-core), you also gain the benefits of Investigating unless you choose not to. When you invest the spectacles, you either increase your Intelligence modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you the higher value. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence modifier. You must select skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _archivist’s gaze_, you get the same skills and languages you picked the first time.

activations.name: Aid from Beyond
activations.text: **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** Adjusting the eyepiece’s focus and asking the entity for help, you cause the spectacles to cast either [_see the unseen_](/spell/see-the-unseen-player-core) or a 3rd-rank [_translate_](/spell/translate-player-core) on you. Because the entity tied to the spectacles chooses which one, the GM picks whichever spell is most immediately useful in your current situation (and chooses the most useful language each time the item casts _translate_). The spell lasts for 1 minute.

Because the entity tied to the spectacles chooses which one, the GM picks whichever spell is most immediately useful in your current situation (and chooses the most useful language each time the item casts _translate_). The spell lasts for 1 minute.

**Bulk** L

This _+1 hand crossbow_ is imbued with an enchantment that provides a momentary burst of enhanced accuracy against those with some protection.

activations.text: ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You fire a bolt from the crossbow that curves slightly in flight. Make a ranged Strike with a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. This attack ignores the target’s cover.
activations.effect: You fire a bolt from the crossbow that curves slightly in flight. Make a ranged Strike with a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. This attack ignores the target’s cover.

name: Arclord Eye
descr:
**Price** 350 gp

**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

These tattoos take the form of an eye nestled within a triangle and are usually worn on the brow; their inks are said to be distilled from rare materials found only within the Crux of Nex. However, their popularity casts some doubt upon this claim. When you target a [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) creature with a magical effect or spell, you reduce the DC of the [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) to 3.

activations.name: Open the Eye
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** For the next 10 minutes, you gain an [imprecise magic sense](/rule/imprecise-senses-rules-2407) with a range of 30 feet. This allows you to detect spells, magical effects, and magical items within range. You also learn the rank or level of such magical effects and their traits. Deceptive illusion magic is not detectable by this magic sense.
activations.effect: For the next 10 minutes, you gain an [imprecise magic sense](/rule/imprecise-senses-rules-2407) with a range of 30 feet. This allows you to detect spells, magical effects, and magical items within range. You also learn the rank or level of such magical effects and their traits. Deceptive illusion magic is not detectable by this magic sense.

name: Arclord's Codex
descr:
**Price** 38,000 gp

**Bulk** L

---

The techniques bound in the spellbooks of the Arclords of Nex are jealously guarded secrets, and an Arclord gives up their grimoire only under the direst of circumstances. These grimoires vary in appearance based on their owner’s taste, but all display the Arclords’ symbol of an eye within a triangle on the cover. Possession of an _Arclord’s codex_ signifies mastery of powerful magic, and anyone who steals such a tome is sure to find themself hunted across the world—or [the multiverse](/rule/the-multiverse-rules-2988), if necessary—by its owner.

activations.name: Third Eye Rejuvenation
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** If your next action is to Cast a prepared 10th-rank arcane spell, the magical energies reinvigorate your spellcasting. You regain access to two spells of 4th rank or lower or one spell of 5th rank or higher that you’ve prepared and already cast today.
activations.effect: If your next action is to Cast a prepared 10th-rank arcane spell, the magical energies reinvigorate your spellcasting. You regain access to two spells of 4th rank or lower or one spell of 5th rank or higher that you’ve prepared and already cast today.

descr:
**Price** 150 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1

**Base Weapon** [Mace](/item/mace-player-core)

---

This imperious _+1 striking mace_ has a glowing orb in the shape of an eye set in its flanged head. When you succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature after you’ve dealt damage to it with the _auspicious scepter_, you learn one of its resistances in addition to any other information.

activations.name: Fortunate Strike
activations.text: **Frequency** once every 10 minutes; **Trigger** Your previous action was to Cast a fortune Spell that targeted a single ally; **Effect** Your luck magic lingers, allowing your target to find a weak spot in an enemy’s defenses. The next Strike made by the target of the triggering fortune spell bypasses an amount of resistance equal to the spell’s rank. This benefit is lost if it isn’t used by the end of your next turn. If more than one type of resistance would apply against the attack, the attack bypasses only one—whichever would result in the highest amount of damage getting through, as determined by the GM.

name: Backdraft Bead
descr:
**Price** 25 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

---

Swirling winds shift and whirl within the confines of this small glass marble. When used as a catalyst to cast a _[_fireball_](/spell/fireball-player-core)_ spell, a creature that fails its saving throw is also knocked back 5 feet from the center of the spell (10 feet on a critical failure).

name: Backfire Mantle
descr:
**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** 1

---

This vivid red cloak of sturdy fabric is favored by aggressive battle alchemists and mages, as well as those cautious warriors who need to advance into the fray ahead of the blast-happy back line. The mantle interposes to protect you from your own and allies’ magic, granting you a circumstance bonus to Reflex saves against your own spells, as well as those of your allies. You also gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) to [splash](/trait/splash) damage from your own [alchemical](/trait/alchemical) items and those of your allies.

## Backfire Mantle

**Price** 45 gp

---

The mantle grants a +1 circumstance bonus and resistance 3.

## Greater Backfire Mantle

**Price** 430 gp

---

The mantle grants a +2 circumstance bonus and resistance 10.

name: Bane
descr:
**Price** 100 gp

**Usage** etched onto a weapon

---

A _bane_ rune grants you improved understanding of creatures of a particular type, allowing you to deal more damage to those creatures. The crafter chooses [aberration](/trait/aberration), [animal](/trait/animal), [beast](/trait/beast), [celestial](/trait/celestial), [construct](/trait/construct), [dragon](/trait/dragon), [elemental](/trait/elemental), [fey](/trait/fey), [fiend](/trait/fiend), [giant](/trait/giant), [monitor](/trait/monitor), [ooze](/trait/ooze), or both [fungus](/trait/fungus) and [plant](/trait/plant). The weapon deals 1d6 additional damage of the weapon's damage type to creatures with the chosen trait or traits. The benefit doesn't apply against creatures of the chosen type disguised as other creatures. It's up to GM discretion whether the _bane_ rune applies against a creature disguised as a creature of the chosen type. The GM might allow _bane_ runes for other creature traits, such as [astral](/trait/astral), [demon](/trait/demon), [dream](/trait/dream), or [vampire](/trait/vampire). However, the [humanoid](/trait/humanoid) trait, the [undead](/trait/undead) trait, and the traits for specific types of humanoids (such as [elf](/ancestry/elf-player-core)) are never a valid option.

name: Beetle Gel
descr:
**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L

---

This midnight-blue gel shimmers with rainbow hues when exposed to light. When you apply this gel on an unattended and non-magical object of 1 Bulk, the object grows iridescent insect wings and transforms into a flash beetle, keeping some of the same colors and patterns of the original item. This false beetle has the [minion](/trait/minion) trait. It remains in this beetle form for 10 minutes before the wings fall off and it returns to normal. If the beetle is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the item returns to its original form, undamaged.

## Beetle Gel

**Price** 10 gp

## Greater Beetle Gel

**Price** 130 gp

---

When the gel is applied to an object of 2 Bulk, that object is transformed into a giant stag beetle.

This grimoire fancifully illustrates the spells you inscribe within it with illuminated drawings of creatures that have never existed, the pictures changing to depict new ones from time to time.

name: Binding Coil
descr:
**Usage** affixed to a weapon

---

This talisman, a bright red coil that is warm to the touch and faintly resembles a serpent, wraps entirely around your weapon. When you activate this talisman’s effect, attempt to [Grapple](/action/grapple-player-core) the creature you damaged; on a success, one end of the coil wraps itself around the target. This has a Grapple’s normal effects, except that the DC to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core) is 20 and you can move without freeing the creature as long as you don’t move further away from it.

## Binding Coil

**Price** 50 gp

## Greater Binding Coil

**Price** 450 gp

---

The DC to Escape is 30.

activation.text: **Trigger** Your Strike with the affixed weapon damages a creature; **Requirements** You’re an expert in Athletics.

name: Blade of Four Energies
descr:
**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

**Base Weapon** [Shortsword](/item/shortsword-player-core)

---

This _+2 greater striking shifting shortsword_ is formed of rapidly vibrating air and magical energy, though it uses the same statistics as iron. The wooden hilt is adorned with four gems, representing the energies of acid, cold, electricity, and fire.

## Blade Of Four Energies

**Price** 3,000 gp

## Greater Blade Of Four Energies

**Price** 20,000 gp

---

The blade is a _+3 greater striking shifting shortsword_ and gains the effects of the _greater corrosive_, _greater flaming_, _greater frost_, or _greater [shock](/item/shock-gm-core)_ runes instead of their base versions. When you use the blade to Release Energy, you Cast the Spell heightened to 7th rank, and the DC is 38.

activations.name: Cycle Energy
activations.text: **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** You draw magical energy from one of the gems. Roll 1d4. Until the start of your next turn, the weapon gains the effects of the corresponding property rune: 1—_corrosive_, 2—_flaming_, 3—_frost_, or 4—_shock_.
activations.effect: You draw magical energy from one of the gems. Roll 1d4. Until the start of your next turn, the weapon gains the effects of the corresponding property rune: 1—_corrosive_, 2—_flaming_, 3—_frost_, or 4—_shock_.

activations.name: Release Energy
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Requirements** The blade has an energy rune from Cycle Energy; **Effect** You call upon the energy stored in the blade to explode outward. You cast a 5th-rank spell that depends on the active rune: _acid grip_ for _corrosive_, __fireball__ for _flaming_, 2-action __howling blizzard__ for _frost_, or __lightning bolt__ for _shock_, with a DC of 30.

---

This _+2 striking holy flail_ doubles as both a hooded lantern and a bludgeoning weapon, giving off bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for the next 30 feet when wielded. The lantern’s light can’t be extinguished by non-magical means. It’s said that an enlightened gravekeeper crafted the first _blessed lantern flail_.

activations.name: Purge Unholy Magic
activations.text:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes; **Effect** You use the flail to temporarily disrupt an unholy spellcaster’s connection to their magic. Make a melee Strike with the flail against an unholy creature with innate or prepared spells. If you hit and deal damage, the target must attempt a DC 31 Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is otherwise unaffected.

**Success** Until the beginning of your next turn, the creature must succeed at a DC 5 flat check to Cast a Spell.

**Failure** As success, but the effect lasts for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the DC of the flat check is 11.

The white leather cover of this book is splotched with rusty red bloodstains, and its pages seep red when turned, although this never stains the bearer’s hands or clothing. Anatomical drawings illustrate its pages.

descr:

**Bulk** L

A circular labyrinth is etched onto this tome’s cover, its lines shimmering silver. Touching the book causes a sense of faint discombobulation.

activations.name: Bewildering Walls
activations.text:
**Frequency** once per day; **Effect** If your next action is to [Cast a prepared Wall Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), such as _[_wall of fire_](/spell/wall-of-fire-player-core)_ or _[_wall of thorns_](/spell/wall-of-thorns-player-core)_, you imbue the wall with an uncanny sense of disorientation, causing creatures to perceive it as an endless labyrinth. Any creature that begins its turn within the wall’s spaces or passes through the wall’s spaces must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, in addition to the wall’s normal effect. Regardless of the results, the target then becomes immune to Bewildering Walls for 24 hours.

**Critical Success** The wall has no additional effect for that creature.

**Success** The creature is bewildered by its perceptions of labyrinthine walls and treats all other creatures as [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature treats all other creatures as [hidden](/condition/hidden-player-core) for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature treats all other creatures as hidden for 1 round and concealed for 1 minute.

---

This potion is a melody in clear liquid form, with little musical notations swimming and darting through it like fish. You gain the Songburst action for 1 hour after you imbibe this concoction.

**Songburst** **Single Action** ([auditory](/trait/auditory), [sonic](/trait/sonic)) You vocalize a high-pitched melody that deals 4d6 sonic damage to all creatures in a 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) (DC 23 [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Fortitude save). name: Calamity's Bane Tattoo
descr:
**Price** 250 gp

**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

This small tattoo of a stylized lidded or clouded eye radiating lines of power is inked on a part of your body that you cannot easily see with your own eyes, such as the nape of your neck, behind your ears, or your interscapular region. This tattoo protects you during calamity as well as uncertainty, guiding your intuition to take subconscious actions and precautions to shelter you in a thousand unknown ways. When you are affected by a [misfortune](/trait/misfortune) effect or a [curse](/trait/curse), your shrouded eye tattoo emits an intense sensation akin to pins and needles, alerting you that something is awry, though the specific nature of the danger might be unknown to you.

name: Cantrip Deck
descr:
**Usage** held in 1 hand

---

Worshippers of [Nethys](/deity/nethys-the-all-seeing-eye-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-288) discovered a way to bind cantrips into cards, making them accessible even to non-spellcasters. The deck contains thick parchment cards, each roughly half the size of a typical playing card. In precise, no-nonsense script, each card simply states the name of its cantrip.

## Cantrip Deck (5-pack)

**Price** 5 gp

---

This pack contains 5 cards of a single common cantrip (such as _light_).

## Full Pack

**Price** 20 gp

---

This pack contains 25 cards—one of each cantrip in _Player Core_.

activations.name: Pick a Card
activations.text: **Single Action or more Actions** ([manipulate](/trait/manipulate)) **Effect** You envision your desired cantrip, causing its card to rise to the top of the deck, and draw the card. The deck casts that cantrip as a 1st-rank spell, with a DC of 15 and a spell attack modifier of +5. The card crumbles into dust as the cantrip takes effect. This activation takes the same number of actions as the cantrip you chose takes to cast.

This black velvet cloak is featureless and very soft to the touch. Upon wearing it for the first time, you’re momentarily overwhelmed with a sense of comfort and coziness. This finely crafted, seemingly mundane parchment is useful for writing sensitive documents. When words are written on this parchment, they instantly scramble into unrecognizable script, requiring a DC 20 check to [Decipher Writing](/action/decipher-writing-player-core). Both of the parchment’s activations require speaking a password or pass phrase, imbued into the parchment when created. A character must critically succeed on the check to [Identify Magic](/action/identify-magic-player-core) when examining the parchment to learn the password.

name: Collar of the Eternal Bond
descr:
**Price** 330 gp

**Usage** worn collar

**Bulk** L

---

When you invest this collar for your eidolon, it changes its appearance to match the eidolon’s form—possibly into a different sort of neckpiece such as a choker—and it glows brightly with the symbol you and your eidolon share. While your eidolon wears a _collar of the eternal bond_, the collar bolsters their connection to you, allowing them to move up to 150 feet from you before unmanifesting instead of 100 feet. The eidolon can also Activate the collar to move even further.

activations.name: Eidolon's Freedom
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** Your eidolon focuses their will on the collar, allowing the collar to maintain the connection between you at any distance. For the next 5 minutes, you and your eidolon can move any distance from each other without your eidolon unmanifesting. When the duration ends, if your eidolon is more than 150 feet from you, they immediately unmanifest.

**Usage** held in 1 hand

This ornate cryptex, made of bronze or similar metals, spins slowly until activated. descr:
**Price** 10 gp

**Ammunition** any

---

The bronze inlays of _daybreak ammunition_ glow noticeably, even under direct sunlight. When activated _daybreak ammunition_ hits a target, the missile flares with an aura of bright light in a 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) from the target for 1 round. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save. Creatures with darkvision take a –2 circumstance penalty to this save.

descr:
**Price** 650 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

**Base Weapon** [Dart](/item/dart-player-core)

---

Forged from black steel, this _+1 striking returning dart_ is etched with runes that shimmer with an iridescent glow. A creature struck and damaged by this dart takes a –2 status penalty to its next saving throw against a magical effect within 1 round. The target then becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.

name: Deck of Mischief
descr:
**Price** 75 gp

**Usage** held in 2 hands

---

This deck of 54 cards appears nearly identical to standard playing cards. Comprised of four thematic suits of 13 cards each, as well as two wildcards, the _deck of mischief_ is a favorite of scoundrels who prefer not to leave their games to chance— or to at least nudge the odds in their favor. If you know how to activate the deck, you can illusorily transform the ace and face cards into other cards in the deck. The deck is true to its name and less likely to comply with your wishes if not well cared for. While surprisingly resistant to the elements, a waterlogged, dirty, or battered deck may not function as desired, giving you incorrect information about which cards are still in the deck or failing to hold the illusion at a critical moment. If a deck becomes incomplete due to damaged or missing cards, it rapidly loses its deceptive capabilities and might even purposefully sabotage you.

activations.name: Card Trick
activations.text: **Effect** You learn which of the ace and face cards are still in the deck. You can then swap the apparent face of an ace or face card in your hand (if you have any) with the face of one still in the deck. A creature who [Seeks](/action/seek-player-core) or touches the card can attempt to disbelieve this illusion ([Perception](/rule/perception-rules-2040) DC 20).

descr:
**Price** 100 gp

**Usage** affixed to armor

---

Given to undisciplined acolytes at risk of breaking their vows, this fulu activates on its own if its wearer begins to perform an act anathema to a specific deity or cause, decided at the time of crafting. The fulu heats up when activated, giving you enough warning to correct your actions; if you proceed, the fulu immolates in a burst of flame. This deals 4d6 fire damage and brands your skin until you receive an appropriate _[atone](/ritual/atone-player-core)_ ritual. Either way, activating the fulu consumes it.

name: Dimensional Knot
descr:
**Price** 60 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

[Shelynites](/deity/shelyn-the-eternal-rose-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-293) originally crafted this complex knot of vibrant string for bracelets meant to tie the destinies of two people together. Now, however, spellcasters of all religions use them to enhance their capacity with teleportation magic. Adding this catalyst to a 4th-rank _[_translocate_](/spell/translocate-player-core)_ spell allows you to bring a single willing adjacent creature along with you; however, the teleportation is somewhat disorienting for them, causing them to become [stunned](/condition/stunned-player-core) 1.

When you activate this talisman, until the end of the current turn, the affixed weapon gains the thrown 20 feet weapon trait, and when you make a thrown [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) with it, it flies back to your hand after the Strike completes. name: Dreamer's Butterfly
descr:
**Price** 150 gp

**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

These twin tattoos, each depicting the ornate wing of a butterfly or moth, are usually placed upon your palms or wrists. While sleeping, this tattoo crafts lucid dreams that don’t disturb your rest; However, when danger arises, these dreams shift to alert you to trouble and shroud you in camouflaging dream-stuff. As a result, you do not take any penalty to [Perception](/rule/perception-rules-2040) checks when asleep. When asleep, you also gain a +2 circumstance to your Will saves against effects with the [dream](/trait/dream) or [sleep](/trait/sleep) traits.

activations.name: Wake the Dream
activations.text:
**Effect** By touching the two halves of the tattoo together, the wings expand to show a small illusory rendition of any effects with the dream or sleep traits you are currently subject to. Onlookers (including yourself) gain a +1 status bonus to checks to Identify Magic of any spells or magical effects with the dream or sleep traits for 1 round.

---

**Special** An adjacent ally can also Activate this effect by touching the two halves of your tattoo together if you are willing or [unconscious](/condition/unconscious-player-core).

name: Echoing Theater
descr:
**Price** 60 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

This small diorama is fashioned like a theater and filled with rough-carved wooden figurines. When used as a catalyst to cast a _[_ghostly tragedy_](/spell/ghostly-tragedy-player-core-2)_ spell, the caster can record the reenactment for later viewing or showing at a different location. This recording lasts for 1 week, and creatures viewing the recording can attempt checks to investigate the event as if they’d been present when the spell was cast. The figurines in an active diorama slowly move in vague approximations of the recorded events until activated for viewing, upon which they crack in half and fall motionless.

name: Emberheart
descr:
**Price** 24,000 gp

**Usage** worn

---

This small, heart-shaped amulet appears to be sculpted from stone with a single streak of [dim light](/rule/dim-light-rules-2403) running through, like an ember just beneath ashes. When worn, the amulet gives off a gentle warmth, akin to being near a fireplace. You gain poison [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 15 when wearing this amulet. When you invest the amulet, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

descr:
**Bulk** L

---

When opened, this grimoire has unlimited pages that, oddly, seem almost eager to transcribe spells. Unlike most grimoires, it has no limits to its number of spells. The grimoire’s eagerness to contain your spells grants you a +1 item bonus to checks to [Learn a Spell](/action/learn-a-spell-player-core) if you do so by transcribing the spell into the grimoire. If you use the grimoire during your daily preparations and are capable of preparing spells of the appropriate rank, the grimoire’s nature leaks into your mind, allowing you to prepare an additional 1st-rank spell.

name: Energy Shield Tunic
descr:
**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L

**Base Armor** [Explorer's Clothing](/item/explorer-s-clothing-player-core)

---

This sleek, color-changing tunic has a higher thread count than most garments. It’s a _+2 greater resilient explorer’s clothing_ that helps the wearer survive powerful energy magic. During your daily preparations, you choose one of the following energy types: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance 10 to the chosen energy type until your next daily preparations. The tunic changes color and gains thematic embroidery to reflect the energy type you’ve chosen. • **Acid** The tunic turns brown and has acid splashes embroidered in bright green thread. • **Cold** The tunic turns sky blue and has snowflakes embroidered in silver thread. • **Electricity** The tunic turns dark gray and has lightning bolts embroidered in light blue thread. • **Fire** The tunic turns orange and has balls of fire embroidered in red and yellow threads. • **Sonic** The tunic turns white and has musical notes embroidered in golden thread.

## Energy Shield Tunic

**Price** 6,500 gp

## Greater Energy Shield Tunic

**Price** 22,500 gp

---

You gain resistance 15 to your chosen energy damage type.

name: Energy Vulnerability
descr:
**Usage** etched onto a weapon

---

A weapon etched with this rune has a sheen of a color corresponding to the energy type chosen when the rune is created: green ([acid](/trait/acid)), blue ([cold](/trait/cold)), white ([electricity](/trait/electricity)), orange ([fire](/trait/fire)), or yellow ([sonic](/trait/sonic)). ---

Malevolent arcane energy leaks from within _escalation ammunition_, sizzling with barely [restrained](/condition/restrained-player-core) contempt. When activated _escalation ammunition_ hits a target, the target must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude save. On a failure, the target rolls the next saving throw it attempts within the next minute against a spell or [magical](/trait/magical) effect twice and takes the worse result.

name: Eye of Enlightenment
descr:
**Price** 25 gp

**Usage** affixed to a weapon

---

This dried eye was plucked from a magical creature. You combine your observation about your enemy’s reaction to your Strike with the stores of magical wisdom within the talisman to try to glean more information about the foe’s true nature. When you activate this talisman, you attempt to [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core) about the creature you hit. If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

activation.text: **Trigger** You succeed at a Strike with the affixed weapon; **Requirements** You’re an expert in Arcana, Nature, Occult, Religion, Society, or a Lore skill.

name: Familiar Tattoo
descr:
**Price** 60 gp

**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

This tattoo is typically in the image of a small animal or of a familiar’s name written in runes. Your familiar can meld into your _familiar tattoo_ to be carried in your skin. The familiar must spend a single action, which has the [magical](/trait/magical) and [move](/trait/move) traits, to meld into or exit your tattoo. It must be adjacent to you to meld into your tattoo, and it exits your tattoo in an open space adjacent to you. Any of the familiar’s companion items remain on it, but it can’t carry any other items with it. This tattoo is non-magical if you don’t have a familiar or if your familiar doesn’t remain present for the entire tattooing process. If your familiar dies, this tattoo loses its magic and becomes a mundane tattoo.

descr:
**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

Many cultures of Golarion have a tattoo that is believed to turn away harm. As such, _warding tattoos_ often resemble whichever dangers are most common to the culture, such as a wild beast in the forests of Kyonin, a whirlpool in the high seas of the Shackles, or the stylized face of a demon in the Sarkoris Scar.

## Warding Tattoo

**Price** 140 gp

## Trail Warding Tattoo

**Price** 250 gp

---

You gain resistance 2 to damage from hazardous terrain and environmental hazards at all times, which increases to 5 when the tattoo is activated.

## Wave Warding Tattoo

**Price** 220 gp

---

In addition to the normal triggers, you can activate the tattoo when you enter an environment where you can’t breathe. When you activate the tattoo, it casts _air bubble_ on you, in addition to the other effects.

## Fiend Warding Tattoo

Uncommon

**Price** 300 gp

---

You gain resistance 2 to spells cast by fiends and magical attacks by fiends at all times, which increases to 5 when the tattoo is activated.

This is a metal drinking flask, 4 inches in diameter and 10 inches tall. Its screw top is covered by four simple metal cups that nest together.

Drinks from the _flask of fellowship_ are entirely social; they won’t intoxicate anyone, nor alleviate serious thirst.

[Light](/spell/light-player-core) refracts in strange ways through these precisely ground glass tiles, lengthening the refracted force and causing it to push back. Worshippers of [Nethys](/deity/nethys-the-all-seeing-eye-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-288) discovered a way to bind cantrips into cards, making them accessible even to non-spellcasters. This pack contains 5 cards of a single common cantrip (such as _light_).

This pack contains 25 cards—one of each cantrip in _Player Core_.

This activation takes the same number of actions as the cantrip you chose takes to cast.

**Price** 40 gp

**Duration** 1 hour

**Usage** affixed to the ground in four spaces along a 10-foot radius circle

This fulu comes in four pieces, one placed in each cardinal direction. Choose one of the following traits when Activating the fulus: [animal](/trait/animal), [beast](/trait/beast), [celestial](/trait/celestial), [fey](/trait/fey), [fiend](/trait/fiend), [humanoid](/trait/humanoid), [monitor](/trait/monitor), [plant](/trait/plant), or [undead](/trait/undead). Those within the fulus’ circle upon activation (including the fulus themselves) gain the effects of _[_shared invisibility_](/spell/shared-invisibility-player-core-2)_, except that the area is the fulus’ circle instead of an [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) and the invisibility is only effective against creatures with the chosen trait. If any of the fulus are moved or destroyed after activation, the effect ends.

name: Fulu of Fire Suppression
descr:
**Price** 10 gp

**Duration** 1 week

**Usage** affixed to a wall

---

The silver ink on this black paper charm ebbs in and out of sight, especially when caught out of the corner of your eye. Usually placed in the kitchen, this fulu slows the spread of fire in a 30-foot radius by half. If the fulu itself catches fire, as it burns, it releases a shower of water in a 30-foot [cone](/rule/cone-rules-2386), automatically putting out non-magical fires in this area and attempting to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) any magical fire effects with a +7 counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 2; when this happens, the fulu’s duration ends early.

name: Fulu of Flood Suppression
descr:
**Price** 10 gp

**Duration** 1 week

**Usage** affixed to a wall

---

This blue fulu bears dark ink that slowly swirls and twists about itself, expanding and contracting on the paper over the course of the day in time with the tides. This fulu is most effective in the lowest area of a building or near the most valuable or least waterproof items. They’re often seen as the rainy season approaches, with demand spiking just before a particularly large storm hits. The fulu slows the spread of flooding water in a 30-foot radius by half, repelling the remaining water away. If the fulu becomes submersed, as the ink dissolves in the water, it releases a rush of heat in a 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387), harmlessly vaporizing non-magical water in this area into steam and attempting to counteract any magical water effects with a +7 counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 2; when this happens, the fulu’s duration ends early.

The monkey on this fulu sits on the point of the armor just over the bearer’s stomach, happily drinking any intoxicants that come flowing down. When you activate the fulu, you gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering Fortitude save and to Fortitude saves against the same poison for the next minute. If the triggering poison was normal alcohol, you instead automatically succeed at the triggering save and gain a +4 status bonus on saves against alcohol for 1 minute.

Translucent and nearly weightless, this opalescent paint seems to resolve into occult symbols if stared at too long. When used to cover a 5-foot-wide, 10-foot-tall section of a wall, the paint turns that section of wall ghostly and incorporeal to a depth of 10 feet, allowing corporeal creatures and objects to pass through it. The portal persists for 10 minutes. When this effect wears off, anything remaining within the portal is shunted to the nearest exit. Force effects, other [incorporeal](/trait/incorporeal) objects and creatures, and _[ghost touch](/item/ghost-touch-gm-core)_ weapons can’t cross through the wall, as is normal for incorporeality. An incorporeal creature that’s inside the wall when the paint is used is shunted to the nearest exit.

These wire-rim glasses with large, circular lenses were invented for the sole purpose of avoiding awkward confrontations at social gatherings. They grant you a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy.

The glasses rely on your latent memories, so if the creature is disguising their identity, the glasses don't penetrate the disguise. For example, if a divoynik was disguised as an innkeeper you met, the glasses would give you the innkeeper's name, and if a noble you met before was in disguise as a masked vigilante, the glasses wouldn't reveal their true name.

activations.name: Patchwork Double
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You tear off a patch of cloth to manifest it into a copy of yourself, dressed in your normal clothes, though they resemble the color and fabric of the patch. The copy follows your specific instructions and performs a single, straightforward task for up to 30 minutes. It takes the copy three times as long to complete the task as it would you, meaning it can perform a task that would take you a maximum of 10 minutes. It doesn’t react quickly enough to be of any use during an encounter, and it can’t use your spells or other special abilities—just basic actions and skill actions. The copy disappears and returns to the hat as a piece of cloth when the given task has been completed or when you [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) Patchwork Double.

This [thieves’ toolkit](/item/thieves-toolkit-player-core) provides its owner the ability to have continued control over a lock while leaving it in place. It grants a +1 item bonus to Thievery checks to [Pick a Lock](/action/pick-a-lock-player-core). Upon completely opening a lock by picking it with this toolkit, the toolkit produces a temporary copy of the key for the picked lock. This phantom key can lock or unlock the lock just like the original key. The key appears attached to the thieves’ toolkit by a fine silver chain and lasts for 12 hours before it fades into nothing. ---

This talisman takes the form of a flower from the sweetbriar rose, also called the eglantine rose, tied to the weapon with a bit of string. The talisman’s enchantment is such that the flower never wilts. When you activate it, your weapon becomes difficult to look at for 1 minute, as through a shimmer of heat or something seen out of the corner of your eye. While this effect is active, you gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks to [Feint](/action/feint-player-core). descr:

_Magekiller bullets_ are forged by carving a spellcaster's bones with sigils of unbinding, grinding them to powder, and sealing the powder within the core of specially made rounds or sling bullets. When an activated _magekiller bullet_ hits a target, the ammunition burrows deep into its body and interferes with its connection to magic. Each time within the next week an affected target [Casts a Spell](/rule/cast-a-spell-rules-3144), it must attempt a DC 11 [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278). On a failure, it takes 2d12 force damage. This curse can be counteracted with [_cleanse affliction_](/spell/cleanse-affliction-player-core) as normal, but if the ammunition is first removed from the target with a successful DC 35 Medicine check and an operation that takes 1 hour, the counteract check gains a +4 circumstance bonus.

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

This small, silver disc is engraved with a leering, disgusting face on one side and an image of one thing the observer finds repellent on the other; the latter changes with every viewer. When the token is used as a catalyst to cast a _[_repulsion_](/spell/repulsion-player-core)_ spell, you hurl it to an ally within 30 feet. name: Orchestral Brooch
descr:
**Price** 100 gp

**Usage** affixed to armor

---

This silver brooch reverberates lightly with the sound of music every time anyone touches it. You can transform it into the shape of any chosen instrument when you Affix it. When you activate this talisman, your performance is accompanied by a grand procession of music that complements your own work, subject to your direction and intent. You receive a +1 status bonus to your Performance check. If you roll a success, you get a critical success instead. After being used, the talisman remains as a mundane silver brooch with the appearance of the chosen instrument, though it possesses no remaining power.

activation.text: **Trigger** You attempt a Performance check, but you haven’t rolled yet; **Requirements** You’re a master in Performance.

name: Possum's Play
descr:
**Usage** affixed to armor

---

This innocuous little charm looks like nothing so much as a patch of coarse white or dark gray fur, usually made to resemble a lucky rabbit’s foot or something else. When you activate the talisman, the triggering attack gains the [nonlethal](/trait/nonlethal) trait, and you fall [prone](/condition/prone-player-core), feigning death. An [illusion](/trait/illusion) surrounds you, causing you to appear dead for up to 1 minute. Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the [Seek](/action/seek-player-core) action to examine you can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. The DC to disbelieve the illusion is 18. Any action requiring you to move or make noise immediately ends the illusion.

## Possum's Play

**Price** 20 gp

## Greater Possum's Play

**Price** 150 gp

---

The DC is 24, and the illusion lasts for up to 1 hour

## Major Possum's Play

**Price** 1,300 gp

---

The DC is 34, and the illusion lasts for up to 24 hours.

name: Potion of Grounding
descr:
**Price** 185 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

Sparks flash within this amber syrup. Drinking this potion turns you into a living lightning rod for 1 minute, drawing nearby electricity to strike you instead of allies. You gain the following reaction while the effect lasts.

**Divert Lightning** **Reaction** ([electricity](/trait/electricity)) **Trigger** A creature within 30 feet of you is targeted by an electricity effect or is in the area of an electricity effect; **Requirements** You aren't immune to electricity; **Effect** You draw the electricity to yourself like a lightning rod to shield the target. If the triggering effect was targeted, it targets you instead of the triggering creature. If it was an area effect, it leaps from the triggering creature's space to fill your space instead. This doesn't divert lightning from any other creatures targeted by or in the area of the lightning. You're automatically hit by or automatically fail your save against the effect. You then can't Divert Lightning for 1d4 rounds.

name: Potion of Living Light
descr:
**Price** 200 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

This glass vial has a dusky purple liquid with a small orb of light suspended in it. It sheds [bright light](/rule/bright-light-rules-2402) in a 5-foot radius. Upon drinking the potion, your skin sheds an aura of bright light in a 20-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) (and [dim light](/rule/dim-light-rules-2403) for another 20 feet), even through your clothing and armor, for 1 hour. While glowing, you gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against [darkness](/trait/darkness) and [shadow](/trait/shadow) effects. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) this effect, causing a flash of light that causes every creature in a 20-foot emanation to be [blinded](/condition/blinded-player-core) for 1 round unless they succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save.

name: Potion of Minute Echoes
descr:
**Price** 125 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

No matter how carefully you open this bottle, it always lets out an audible, echoing pop. For 1 minute after drinking this potion, you gain a +2 status bonus to [Perception](/rule/perception-rules-2040) checks to hear. In addition, each time you [Seek](/action/seek-player-core), your hearing becomes a [precise sense](/rule/senses-rules-2405) until the beginning of your next turn, allowing you to pinpoint creatures’ locations and otherwise perceive the world in detail by listening to the sound of echoes.

name: Potion of Stable Form
descr:
**Usage** held in 1 hand

---

This aromatic potion is brewed from the white flowers and black roots of a rare herb. When you drink this potion, it immediately attempts to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) all hostile [morph](/trait/morph) and [polymorph](/trait/polymorph) effects affecting you. For the next hour, you gain an item bonus to saving throws against morph and polymorph effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a polymorph effect during that time, you get a critical success instead.

**Price** 180 gp

---

The counteract rank is 5, and the counteract check modifier is +17. The item bonus is +3.

## Greater Potion Of Stable Form

**Price** 1,800 gp

---

The counteract rank is 8, and the counteract check modifier is +25. The item bonus is +4.

name: Rebound Fulu
descr:
**Price** 125 gp

**Usage** affixed to a shield

---

The bronze-colored ink on this pale, silvery talisman sharply reflects light, enough that it seems to glow. When you activate the fulu, it reflects your foe’s violence back against them. The foe that triggered the [Shield Block](/feat/shield-block-player-core) reaction takes damage equal to your shield’s [Hardness](/rule/hardness-rules-2183) or the damage they would’ve dealt before the Shield Block reaction, whichever is less.

activation.text: **Trigger** You use the Shield Block reaction with the shield to which this fulu is affixed.

name: Rebounding Breastplate
descr:
**Price** 70,000 gp

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 2

**Base Armor** [Breastplate](/item/breastplate-player-core)

---

This _+3 greater resilient greater fortification breastplate_ absorbs impacts for later release. While wearing the armor, you gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and resistance 10 to force damage. Keep track of how much damage the armor prevents from enemy attacks, as the armor absorbs that damage. After 1 minute, the absorbed damage disperses harmlessly and resets to 0. Only damage caused by foes or hazards powers the armor, not damage you take from yourself, allies, or the environment.

Creatures in a 30-foot emanation take 12d6 force damage with a DC 43 basic Fortitude save. On a failure, they’re also pushed 10 feet away from you; on a critical failure, they’re instead pushed 20 feet away from you and fall prone. The armor’s absorbed damage resets to 0.

---

The edges of this large tower shield ([Hardness](/rule/hardness-rules-2183) 12, HP 96, BT 48) are dented and worn, bearing the scuffs and marks of decades of battle.

activations.text: **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You have the _resolute shield_ raised, and you would take physical damage from a critically successful attack; **Effect** The _resolute shield_ prevents you from taking an amount of damage up to twice the shield’s Hardness. You and the shield each take any remaining damage.

name: Resonating Ammunition
descr:
**Price** 300 gp

**Ammunition** arrow, bolt

---

The end of this ammunition is a metallic tuning fork with magical etchings. When an activated piece of _resonating ammunition_ hits its target, the tuning fork resonates with residual energy from the shot, transforming it into dangerous sound waves. This deals 5d10 sonic damage to the target and each creature within a 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) (DC 28 [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Fortitude save).

name: Restful Sleep Fulu
descr:
**Price** 32 gp

**Usage** affixed to a creature

---

This fulu depicts the five-spoke wheel of [Qi Zhong](/deity/qi-zhong-master-of-medicine-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-314), god of magic and medicine, and burns away slowly like incense. If you fall asleep with the fulu attached to you and during the fulu’s duration, you regain double the amount of Hit Points you usually gain from resting. You also gain a +2 status bonus to saves against [mental](/trait/mental) effects that occur in your dreams, such as the _[nightmare](/spell/nightmare-player-core)_ spell, for as long as you remain asleep.

name: Retrieval Prism
descr:
**Usage** affixed to armor

---

This triangular prism showing swirling black patterns inside constantly moves around on your armor, no matter where you affix it. As part of the process of Affixing this Talisman, you attune it to a single item of 1 Bulk or less. When you activate this talisman, the attuned item immediately teleports into your hand. The retrieval prism can’t retrieve an item that’s not on your plane, including one that’s in an extradimensional space like a _spacious pouch_. If you haven’t expended the talisman, you can attune it to a different item by Affixing the Talisman again.

## Retrieval Prism

**Price** 12 gp

## Greater Retrieval Prism

**Price** 200 gp

---

You don’t need to attune the prism. It can retrieve any item in your possession of 1 Bulk or less when you activate the prism.

name: Robe of Beneficence
descr:
**Price** 14,000 gp

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L

**Base Armor** [Explorer's Clothing](/item/explorer-s-clothing-player-core)

---

This soft, buttery smooth robe is _+2 greater resilient explorer’s clothing_ made from silk and unicorn hair. The back and shoulders are appliquéd with clusters of angel feathers to form a motif of unfurled wings. On this robe are subtle arabesques, loops, and curlicues that are pleasing to the eye and evoke a sense of calm. When you wear this robe, you gain an invisible aura of purity and kindness that extends from you in a 30-foot emanation, granting you a +3 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression and to make Requests of creatures who are within your aura.

activations.name: Compelled Nonviolence
activations.text:
**Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The wings of this robe extend, and your aura glows golden, briefly becoming visible as it does. Creatures within your aura who are hostile, indifferent, or unfriendly to you must attempt a DC 36 Will saving throw with the following effects.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is stunned 1.

**Failure** The creature is stunned 2.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the creature can’t use any hostile action against you for 1 round.

name: Rune of Sin
descr:
**Price** 1,700 gp

**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

This jagged glyph matches one of the Thassilonian runes of sin—envy, gluttony, greed, lust, pride, sloth, or wrath— chosen when the tattoo is created. When you [Cast a Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) from the arcane tradition, the tattoo shimmers with energy, granting you [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 10 to damage from divine spells until the start of your next turn.

name: Runeveil Ammunition
descr:
**Price** 30 gp

**Ammunition** any

---

Pulsing, cracked glyphs scar the surface of _runeveil ammunition_, seeming to flake and crumble when handled roughly. When activated _runeveil ammunition_ hits a target that can [Cast Spells](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), it’s engulfed in a personal cloud of glowing dust. Until the beginning of your next turn, the target takes a –2 status penalty to spell attack rolls and spell DCs.

name: Safeguarding
descr:
**Price** 2,600 gp

**Usage** etched onto armor

---

Your armor is overlayed with a shimmering mosaic of pink, turquoise, and blue energy that protects the most vital aspects of your person. When activated, the armor’s hue shifts according to the type of resistance you gain: turquoise ([mental](/trait/mental)), blue ([poison](/trait/poison)), or pink ([spirit](/trait/spirit)).

activations.name: Adaptive Aegis
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You would take mental, poison, or spirit damage; **Effect** You gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 5 to the triggering damage type that lasts for 10 minutes.
activations.effect: You gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 5 to the triggering damage type that lasts for 10 minutes.

name: Sage's Lash
descr:
**Price** 24,000 gp

**Usage** worn belt

**Bulk** 1

---

The thin, glittering strands of rope that form this thick belt appear to be spun gold. Strung along the front of the belt are a collection of four multicolored, perfectly spherical beads: amethyst, jade, quartz, and turquoise. While wearing the lash, you gain a +3 item bonus to Religion. When you invest the belt, you either increase your Wisdom modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

activations.name: Jewel of the Mind
activations.text:
**Effect** You touch one of the jewels affixed to the _sage’s lash_ and think the associated command word. Depending on the jewel, a different effect is produced that affects you and all living creatures in a 30-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387). After the effect occurs, all four jewels disappear from the lash, reappearing at the next dawn.
**• Amethyst** (light, revelation) Think “verity” to emit a magical trail of light from the lash that reveals the location of each creature in the emanation. For 1 round, if they would be [invisible](/condition/invisible-player-core), they become [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) instead, and if they would be [undetected](/condition/undetected-player-core) or [unnoticed](/condition/unnoticed-player-core) by a creature, they’re [hidden](/condition/hidden-player-core) instead. A creature can attempt a DC 43 Stealth check to avoid the lash’s detection.
**• Jade** (healing) Think “purity” to produce a wave of green light that ends any [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) condition and any [persistent poison damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) affecting creatures in the emanation.
**• Quartz** (healing, vitality) Think “lenity” to have each creature regain 30 Hit Points.
**• Turquoise** Think “clarity” to grant all affected creatures a +2 status bonus to their next Will save for 1 minute.

descr:
**Price** 90 gp

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L

---

This vial contains a dark, silvery-gray salve. When you apply this salve to a willing creature, it congeals into an intricate mesh of lacy fractals that covers the target’s body, granting the target [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 10 to [mental](/trait/mental) damage for 10 minutes, after which the mesh flakes off into powdery crumbs.

name: Self-sealing
descr:
**Price** 320 gp

**Usage** etched onto armor

---

A suit of armor etched with this rune can create a bolstering magical layer that closes off to protect the wearer against dangerous environments. When you would take environmental damage, or when you enter an environment where you can’t safely breathe, your _self-sealing_ armor seals itself shut. It holds 1 minute’s worth of air and grants you [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 10 to environmental damage while sealed. You or another creature can take an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action to unseal it at any time. Once unsealed, the armor can’t seal itself again for 1 hour.

---

This _+1 striking whip_ was fashioned with the enchanted leather of a giant serpent. Several vicious fangs are embedded in the thong and fall of the whip. When wielded in combat, the weapon emanates a faint rattling sound.

Crafted out of spite to counter a caster’s animated objects, _shatterpoint ammunition_ hums quiet songs of destruction. The ammunition ignores the target’s Hardness if it’s 12 or lower and deals 3d8 persistent sonic damage.

---

The surface of this steel buckler ([Hardness](/rule/hardness-rules-2183) 6, HP 24, BT 12) has been brushed into soft swirling patterns that evoke snowstorms. ---

This massive steel shield ([Hardness](/rule/hardness-rules-2183) 8, HP 32, BT 16) is engraved with the image of a roaring face of a bear and lined with patches of bear fur. When you have this shield raised, if any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you’re moved 5 fewer feet.

---

This luminous mica dust fluoresces for a short time after being exposed to significant amounts of magical energy. A suit of armor etched with this rune can cause its wearer’s form to vibrate slightly out of phase with the rest of the world, allowing them to impossibly pass through solid objects.

This magically reinforced wooden shield ([Hardness](/rule/hardness-rules-2183) 6, HP 36, BT 18) normally has a blank face. It can absorb a staff and transform between a shield and staff. When used as a catalyst to cast a _[_weapon storm_](/spell/weapon-storm-player-core)_ spell, the caster’s weapon propels them forward. Before choosing the spell’s area, [Stride](/action/stride-player-core) up to twice your Speed. This movement must be in a straight [line](/rule/line-rules-2388) and doesn’t trigger reactions. The spell is then cast from your new location.

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1

**Base Shield** Steel Shield

---

This matte black _moderate reinforcing steel shield_ (Hardness 10, HP 92, BT 46) seems to absorb sound, creating an eerie void around its wielder.

descr:
**Price** 300 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

Blood stains this performer’s mask, which is decorated in both comedy and tragedy motifs and carved with prayers to gods of deception. When used as a catalyst to cast a _[_mislead_](/spell/mislead-player-core)_ spell, it tweaks the magical energy used to create the duplicate, allowing you to alter its appearance to resemble any [humanoid](/trait/humanoid) creature of your size you’ve seen.

name: Stormbreaker Fulu
descr:
**Price** 1,900 gp

**Usage** affixed to armor

---

This unassuming paper tag is inscribed with magical symbols. When you activate the fulu, it vanishes in a wisp of cloud, and you gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 15 to [cold](/trait/cold), [electricity](/trait/electricity), and [sonic](/trait/sonic) damage until the end of your next turn. For that duration, you [ignore difficult terrain](/rule/ignore-difficult-terrain-rules-2367) from wind and weather, and you can’t be forcibly moved or teleported unless the effect [counteracts](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) the fulu (DC 40). These protections apply against the triggering effect.

name: Stormfeather
descr:
**Price** 100 gp

**Usage** affixed to armor

---

Even while affixed, this electric blue feather sways lightly in the air, as if always accompanied by a breeze. When activated, the talisman casts a _[_fly_](/spell/fly-player-core)_ spell on you, though the duration is 1 minute. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) this activation. If you do, you’re affected by _[_gentle landing_](/spell/gentle-landing-player-core)_.

descr:

**Bulk** L

---

This green spellbook with gold trim contains a cautionary story about a boy who was eaten by a wolf after he previously lied about wolf attacks. When opened, the engravings on the front seem to move in a loop, enacting this story.

name: Thousand-Blade Thesis
descr:
**Price** 600 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

This collection of lacquered rice paper scrolls mounted on flexible bamboo contains a wealth of calligraphic essays and paintings on the art of war, specifically focused on the use of various weapons in warfare and how to tactically deploy warriors using those weapons to the best possible advantage. Consulting the thesis grants a +2 item bonus to Warfare Lore checks to [Recall Knowledge](/rule/recall-knowledge-rules-2638). Like most scholarly compendiums, this usage requires holding the thesis in one hand. The thesis also serves as an extradimensional armory for weapons and ammunition. The thesis has a capacity of 5 Bulk, and only weapons and ammunition can be stored within it. You and others can Interact with the thesis to store or retrieve a weapon or piece of ammunition in it, like a mundane container.

activations.name: Instant Armory
activations.text: **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _thousand-blade thesis_ dramatically unfurls, and the weapons contained within it spring forth and array themselves impressively in the air, floating within easy reach. For 1 minute, you can Interact as a free action to draw one of the floating weapons. Others can attempt to nab them out of the air, but to do so they must critically succeed at a [Disarm](/action/disarm-player-core) check (DC 25). You can’t place weapons back into the thesis until the minute elapses.

You can’t place weapons back into the thesis until the minute elapses.

name: Three Bird Pinion
descr:
**Price** 100 gp

**Usage** affixed to armor

---

This talisman is made using the interlocking feathers gathered from at least three kinds of birds, carefully trimmed into a circle. When you activate this talisman, you become lighter than air, causing you to levitate 1 foot off the ground for 1 minute. While levitated this way, you can still move as normal, but you [ignore most difficult, greater difficult, and hazardous terrain](/rule/ignore-difficult-terrain-rules-2367) on the ground.

name: Thunderbird Tuft
descr:
**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

This carved chunk of amber contains a single tuft of gray feathers, which spark with electricity to create an odd jittery sensation in anyone holding the amber for long. When used as part of a _[_thunderstrike_](/spell/thunderstrike-player-core)_ spell, the _thunderbird tuft_ funnels electricity back into the spellcaster in a defensive nimbus. For 1 minute, any creature that touches you or that hits you with a melee unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon attack takes the listed electricity damage.

## Lesser Thunderbird Tuft

**Price** 3 gp

---

The nimbus deals 1d4 electricity damage, or 1d6 electricity damage if the creature is using a metal weapon. The nimbus only lasts 1 round, rather than the full minute.

## Moderate Thunderbird Tuft

**Price** 25 gp

---

The nimbus deals 1d4 electricity damage, or 1d6 electricity damage if the creature is using a metal weapon.

## Greater Thunderbird Tuft

**Price** 125 gp

---

The nimbus deals 2d4 electricity damage, or 2d6 electricity damage if the creature is using a metal weapon.

## Major Thunderbird Tuft

**Price** 500 gp

---

The nimbus deals 3d4 electricity damage, or 3d6 electricity damage if the creature is using a metal weapon.

name: Titan's Grasp
descr:
**Price** 24,000 gp

**Usage** worn gloves

**Bulk** L

---

These bronze gauntlets each have a small red gem embedded in the wrist. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks and a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [Grapple](/action/grapple-player-core). If you successfully Grapple an enemy that’s at least one size category larger than you, the gauntlets dig into it, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier, plus an additional 2d6 on a critical success. When you invest the gloves, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

activations.text:
**Frequency** once per day; **Requirements** You have two hands free; **Effect** You clap the gauntlets together with a thunderous crack that deals 6d10 sonic damage in a 30-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387). Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 35 Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is [deafened](/condition/deafened-player-core) for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is [stunned](/condition/stunned-player-core) 1.

name: Topology Protoplasm
descr:
**Price** 70 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

This slimy gel wriggles to the touch, as if covered by a multitude of imperceptible cilia. If applied to a creature or object no larger than 7 feet in any dimension, the protoplasm shifts it into an ooze-like state for 1 minute, allowing the subject to squash and stretch harmlessly. In this state, a creature that attempts a check to [Squeeze](/action/squeeze-player-core) uses the outcome one degree of success better than it rolls and can move its full Speed while Squeezing, and an object can fit through a space 2 feet across. One vial can cover a creature or object of up to Large size, but as each vial is made from a specific ooze, multiple vials can’t be combined to cover a larger object, as the two gels simply negate each other.

name: Tracking Fulu
descr:
**Price** 25 gp

**Usage** affixed to creature or object

---

Used covertly by assassins and spies, this pair of fulus stick to one another when created but can be easily separated. Affix one fulu to a target before activating its pair. When activated, the unaffixed fulu flutters toward the affixed one at a Speed of 30 feet per round, traveling for up to 1 hour and fluttering more rapidly the closer it comes to its pair. The unaffixed fulu always moves in a straight line toward the affixed fulu; it can’t solve mazes or find its way through winding paths.

name: Trail Warding Tattoo
descr:
**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

Many cultures of Golarion have a tattoo that is believed to turn away harm. As such, _warding tattoos_ often resemble whichever dangers are most common to the culture, such as a wild beast in the forests of Kyonin, a whirlpool in the high seas of the Shackles, or the stylized face of a demon in the Sarkoris Scar.

## Warding Tattoo

**Price** 140 gp

## Trail Warding Tattoo

**Price** 250 gp

---

You gain resistance 2 to damage from hazardous terrain and environmental hazards at all times, which increases to 5 when the tattoo is activated.

## Wave Warding Tattoo

**Price** 220 gp

---

In addition to the normal triggers, you can activate the tattoo when you enter an environment where you can’t breathe. When you activate the tattoo, it casts _air bubble_ on you, in addition to the other effects.

## Fiend Warding Tattoo

Uncommon

**Price** 300 gp

---

You gain resistance 2 to spells cast by fiends and magical attacks by fiends at all times, which increases to 5 when the tattoo is activated.

name: True Endless Grimoire
descr:
**Bulk** L

---

When opened, this grimoire has unlimited pages that, oddly, seem almost eager to transcribe spells. Unlike most grimoires, it has no limits to its number of spells. The grimoire’s eagerness to contain your spells grants you a +1 item bonus to checks to [Learn a Spell](/action/learn-a-spell-player-core) if you do so by transcribing the spell into the grimoire. If you use the grimoire during your daily preparations and are capable of preparing spells of the appropriate rank, the grimoire’s nature leaks into your mind, allowing you to prepare an additional 1st-rank spell.

**Bulk** 1

## Staff Of The Desert Winds

**Price** 230 gp

---

- **Cantrip** [_know the way_](/spell/know-the-way-player-core)
- **1st** [_create water_](/spell/create-water-player-core), [_vanishing tracks_](/spell/vanishing-tracks-player-core)
- **2nd** [_create food_](/spell/create-food-player-core), [_environmental endurance_](/spell/environmental-endurance-player-core)

name: Undertaker's Spade
descr:
**Price** 125 gp

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

Rites of rest are etched deep into the broken-off blade of a deceased gravekeeper’s shovel. When used as a catalyst to cast an _[_impaling spike_](/spell/impaling-spike-player-core)_ spell, the blade disintegrates into dust, mixing with the earth and allowing the spell to damage [incorporeal](/trait/incorporeal) creatures as if it were a weapon imbued with a _ghost touch_ property rune. An incorporeal creature can be [immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core) by a spike if it’s adjacent to a solid surface when struck; it can attempt to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core) as normal but can’t phase through the spike or escape to the Ethereal Plane.

name: Unnerving
descr:
**Price** 350 gp

**Usage** etched onto armor

---

The sound of weapons clanging against a suit of _unnerving_ armor transforms into an inhuman screech that unsettles enemies and makes them hesitate to attack again. Any creature that hits you with a melee [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its next melee Strike that targets you before the end of your next turn.

name: Vapor Sphere
descr:
**Price** 900 gp

**Usage** affixed to armor

---

Within this strange glass sphere swirls a cloud of smoke that occasionally appears as if it’s trying to escape. You react to a surprise encounter with haste, activating this talisman and causing your body to momentarily become like vapor. Against the trap’s reaction or the attack, you gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) 25 to physical damage and are immune to precision damage. This effect also prevents the reaction or attack from physically moving you (such as falling down a pit or being knocked [prone](/condition/prone-player-core)), and after the reaction or attack, you can [Fly](/action/fly-player-core) 5 feet. When you end this flight, you leave your vaporous state and are exposed to any danger still at your location.

activation.text: **Trigger** You trigger a trap’s reaction or an enemy that was [undetected](/condition/undetected-player-core) by you makes an attack against you; **Requirements** You’re an expert in the affixed armor and an expert in Reflex saves.

This green fulu depicts venomous creatures and vermin. When activated, the venom from the fulu fights against the venom in your system, granting you a +2 status bonus to the triggering saving throw.

name: Warding Tattoo
descr:
**Usage** tattooed on the body

---

Many cultures of Golarion have a tattoo that is believed to turn away harm. As such, _warding tattoos_ often resemble whichever dangers are most common to the culture, such as a wild beast in the forests of Kyonin, a whirlpool in the high seas of the Shackles, or the stylized face of a demon in the Sarkoris Scar.

## Warding Tattoo

**Price** 140 gp

## Trail Warding Tattoo

**Price** 250 gp

---

You gain resistance 2 to damage from hazardous terrain and environmental hazards at all times, which increases to 5 when the tattoo is activated.

## Wave Warding Tattoo

**Price** 220 gp

---

In addition to the normal triggers, you can activate the tattoo when you enter an environment where you can’t breathe. When you activate the tattoo, it casts _air bubble_ on you, in addition to the other effects.

## Fiend Warding Tattoo

Uncommon

**Price** 300 gp

---

You gain resistance 2 to spells cast by fiends and magical attacks by fiends at all times, which increases to 5 when the tattoo is activated.

descr:

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

---

name: Wormhole Shot
descr:
**Price** 7 gp

**Ammunition** arrow, bolt

---

The shaft of a _wormhole shot_ gleams like polished ebony and seems to be not quite straight; nevertheless, this ammunition flies true. When an activated _wormhole shot_ hits a target, which can be an unoccupied square, it embeds itself and remains active for up to 1 minute. A creature can [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) to dislodge the ammunition, but it remains active unless the creature spends another Interact action to destroy it. Once during the _wormhole shot_’s duration, if you’re within 60 feet of it, you can use it as the point of origin for a spell or ranged attack, calculating range and cover from whatever space the _wormhole shot_ is in. After being used this way, it quickly dissolves into black dust.
